changeSet.author: jordi.jaspers
changeSet.comment: Backfill watchlist_channel from existing watchlist JSONB configuration (standalone channelIds and group channelIds).
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO watchlist_channel (watchlist_id, channel_id) SELECT w.id, ch.value::int FROM watchlist w, jsonb_array_elements(w.configuration->'channelIds') ch(value) WHERE w.configuration->'channelIds' IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT w.id, ch.value::int FROM watchlist w, jsonb_array_elements(w.configuration->'groups') g(grp), jsonb_array_elements(g.grp->'channelIds') ch(value) WHERE w.configuration->'groups' IS NOT NULL ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
